summary: Mock compaction: 2 candidates from the batch.

knowledgeCandidates.title: Use make test-unit while iterating
knowledgeCandidates.content: Run make test-unit during development and reserve make test for final acceptance; the full suite takes several minutes.

knowledgeCandidates.title: Mutations without X-CSRF-Token return 403
knowledgeCandidates.content: Every mutating API request needs the X-CSRF-Token header from login; a missing token surfaces as an empty 403.
